name: 位置番号とスターを備えたファイル見出し
prompt: Create exactly one Japanese Lighthouse file-viewer header component, LH15-0024, as a polished raster design candidate on a pure white canvas. REFERENCE HIERARCHY: input1 is the ORIGINAL Dropbox screenshot and controls the icon geometry, weight, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and visible state; inspect its TOP file header only (source region x47 y170 w1084 h130 of1179x2676). Input2 is our FigCraft MOCK, secondary only for Japanese content and component scope. Correct its rough outline star and wide arrow substitute using the original: selected SOLID five-point star, compact thick open back chevron, and three evenly spaced solid horizontal dots. Input3 supplies white card material/soft depth only. Do not reproduce its content. Isolate the single compact horizontal header; no phone/status bar, image, footer or extra UI. From left: slate back chevron; small Japanese label「資料」; centered two-line filename group「礼拝準備の写真.jpg」above「7件中 2件目」; filled five-point selected star; horizontal three-dot overflow. Preserve all exactly, in one row with generous enough middle width for filename to remain one line. The number2of7 is unchanged. Use the original icon anatomy, never the malformed mock glyphs. Adapt the original black selected star to restrained solid forest green #1F6444 to communicate that same selected state; back and overflow slate #526173. No primary CTA or additional accent. Pure white shallow rounded surface, very fine neutral outline and faint soft shadow, restrained depth, no tinted backdrop. Readable compact hierarchy in Meiryo: filename Regular14/24, back label/position metadata Regular12/16, tracking0; body ink#1D1D1D, metadata#6E6E6E. Match relative role sizing and line breaks; do not bold filename. Render crisp Japanese at large resolution but keep the header approximately7:1 aspect, centered in a landscape white image with modest clean margins. Preserve original spacing relationships, small star/overflow, vertically centered side controls. No extra title, labels, buttons, English captions, watermark, invented controls or device chrome. This is a static candidate only; no implied native/runtime proof.
reviewNotes: Original and mock opened. Original selected filled star restored in forest green; original open back chevron and horizontal dots prioritized over rough mock. Japanese filename and2of7 retained, white shallow surface. Output visually inspected; exact glyph, font and optical measurements unproved; no owner/native/runtime acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
